name: Shopping
steps: Help Stell distract Lune while shopping so he can grab the snacks.
Put the blonde wig on the man and the red hair with coat on the woman.
Place the bear mask on Lune and cover the child with the white ghost sheet.
Drop the box from the top shelf and turn off the store lights.
Give the pink toy to the crying child, then give the phone to Stell to distract Lune.
